robust MDPs in the discounted reward setting. Our results are the first to achieve optimal dependence
simultaneously. We acknowledge, however, two limitations: the reliance on access
to a generative model and the presence of a gap between our upper bound and the minimax lower
bound established in Yang [29]. As part of future work, we aim to develop provable theoretical
guarantees for other settings, including model-free algorithms and offline reinforcement learning.
